editorial_review_row.content: Axi is a legitimate ASIC/FCA-regulated ECN broker scoring 7.2/10 from NAFT in 2026. The $0 minimum deposit with raw spreads from 0.0 pips and sub-30ms execution removes every barrier between you and institutional-grade forex trading. The Axi Select program — funding traders up to $1 million of Axi's capital with no registration fees — is genuinely unique in the market. But the 83.1% retail loss rate is the highest in this review series, and the 220-instrument range limits multi-asset ambitions. Axi is purpose-built for the forex scalper who knows exactly what they want: the cheapest possible ECN access from zero capital with a path to funded trading. If that is you — and you understand the statistical reality — Axi delivers.
